subject: Expansion: Bridgeway tenant - additional projects, keys & rollout playbook
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Gupta <sanjay@bridgewayhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Sep 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Expansion: Bridgeway tenant - additional projects, keys & rollout playbook

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, Bridgeway is ready to onboard three additional projects (PatientSearch, IntakeForms, and ChartAssist) under the existing tenant. To make this low-friction for your engineering teams, I sketched a rollout playbook and a proposed timeline.

High-level asks / constraints from Bridgeway we captured:
- Separate API keys per project (staging + prod)
- Staggered activation to keep cost predictable (start with PatientSearch)
- One PO for the term amendment, ideally effective 2028-10-01
- SOC2 audit evidence for onboarding of additional projects

Proposed next steps (suggested dates):
1) Review & sign Mutual Action Plan (attached) — target 2028-09-28
2) Redwood to provision staging keys for PatientSearch — 2028-10-02
3) Prod key activation after smoke tests (approx 5 business days)
4) Subsequent project activations every 2 weeks (IntakeForms 2028-10-16, ChartAssist 2028-10-30)

Term / commercial ask: you mentioned increasing committed throughput for the account to cover these new apps. We propose a modest amendment: +25% committed token volume, with a 10% expansion discount on top of your current committed rate. If that's acceptable, I will loop in contracts to draft the amendment and Ben can confirm final pricing authority.

I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan and an API key provisioning checklist to speed engineering handoffs. Can you confirm the attendee list for the kickoff and whether your security team needs specific artifacts earlier?

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if needed.

Best,
Monica Patel
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

Attachments: Bridgeway_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v1.pdf (application/pdf), ApiKey_Provisioning_Checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Sanjay Gupta <sanjay@bridgewayhealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Reddy <maya.reddy@bridgewayhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Sep 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion: Bridgeway tenant - additional projects, keys & rollout playbook

Monica —

Appreciate the clear plan. A few follow-ups from our side:
- Security: our InfoSec lead (Maya) asked whether the staging keys can be scoped to IP allow-lists and whether we can force per-key rotation cadence (30 days) via your key management API.
- Billing: procurement prefers one PO for the term amendment, yes. We will need a short summary for our finance team that states the new committed units and the amendment effective date.
- SSO / onboarding: we will want a short runbook for onboarding non-admin engineers — ideally a one-pager.

On the commercial ask: 10% expansion discount sounds reasonable pending the pricing summary. Can you confirm whether quota increases are immediate upon amendment or staged? We want to ensure we don’t suddenly exceed budget before we flip on production keys.

Thanks — I can be on a kick-off call Thursday afternoon if that helps.

—Sanjay
Sanjay Gupta
Head of Platform Engineering, Bridgeway Health
sanjay@bridgewayhealth.com | +1 212-555-0199

Subject: Re: Expansion: Bridgeway tenant - additional projects, keys & rollout playbook

Sanjay —

Great questions. Short answers up front:
- Yes, we can scope staging keys to IP allow-lists and support rotation via our API; I'll include the exact API calls in the runbook.
- Quota increases: we can stage the committed quota so the amendment sets a capped headroom that only goes live once you accept the amendment and we activate production keys for that project. That prevents surprise spend.
- One-pager: attached, see the "quick_onboard_onepager.md" section in the M.A.P. PDF.

Commercial / next steps:
- I've attached pricing_change_summary.xlsx with the +25% committed example and the 10% expansion discount applied. Ben — can you confirm pricing & approve sending the amendment to Bridgeway legal?
- Karthik — can your team prepare the provisioning command examples (IP allow-listing, rotation TTL) and confirm the expected lead time for staging keys?

Proposed kickoff: Thu, 2028-09-28 14:00 PT (30m) — goal: align engineers and agree staging smoke test criteria. If you confirm, I'll send a calendar invite and attach the M.A.P. to the invite.

Best,
Monica

Attachments: pricing_change_summary.xlsx with the +25% committed example and the 10% expansion discount applied. Ben — can you confirm pricing & approve sending the amendment to Bridgeway legal?

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Sep 2028 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expansion: Bridgeway tenant - additional projects, keys & rollout playbook

Monica —

Reviewed the numbers. We can approve the 10% expansion discount for the +25% committed increase; legal will draft the simple amendment once Bridgeway signs the M.A.P. I have looped Laura to confirm billing mechanics for a single PO and the effective date.

Laura — please confirm: can Finance accept a single PO with the amendment effective 2028-10-01 and staged quota activation tied to a prod-key flip? I want to avoid having the quota automatically unblocked on signature alone.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Gupta <sanjay@bridgewayhealth.com>, Maya Reddy <maya.reddy@bridgewayhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Sep 2028 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Expansion: Bridgeway tenant - additional projects, keys & rollout playbook

Sanjay / Maya —

Thanks for the quick responses and for confirming the kickoff time. Confirming the plan we agreed on today:
- Kickoff: Thu, 2028-09-28 14:00 PT (cal invite to follow)
- M.A.P. to be signed by Bridgeway legal: target 2028-09-29
- Redwood to provision staging keys for PatientSearch on 2028-10-02 (scoped to IP allow-list)
- Prod activation gated on passing smoke test and PO receipt; quota increases staged and only enabled per-project at prod key flip
- Key rotation: we will enable per-key TTL of 30 days; engineering runbook will show API rotation sample calls

I've attached the final checklist for engineering handoff and the pricing summary Ben approved. Please see the Drive folder for the SOC2 artifact snapshot — Maya, if you want different docs early, tell me which report you need and I'll prioritize.

See you on Thursday.

Best,
Monica Patel
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
